posts.title: Welcome to your clinic website
posts.excerpt: Clinic Starter is installed. Update hours, services, and contact details next.
posts.content:
This is the Clinic Starter flagship.

Patients can already browse sample tips and reach your Contact page. Replace every sample with accurate medical and administrative information for your practice.

Important: Do not present sample tips as clinical advice — rewrite them for your specialty and local guidelines.

posts.title: What to bring to your first visit
posts.excerpt: Sample checklist patients can follow before an appointment.
posts.content:
• Photo ID and insurance card (if applicable)
  • List of current medications
  • Questions you want to ask
  • Arrival 10–15 minutes early for forms

Edit this list to match your intake process.

posts.title: New evening hours starting next month
posts.excerpt: Sample announcement — swap for a real schedule change.
posts.content:
Sample news. Announce extended hours, a new clinician, or holiday closures here.

Clear dates and phone numbers reduce no-shows and front-desk calls.

pages.title: About
